newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.00 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 50 billion dong ($4.29 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 12.00 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on March 12, the central bank issued 38 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.60 percent.
The bank said stock was allocated to all three bidders, whose bids came to 56 billion dong.
Allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 44.0 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 1.0 billion
Phuong Nam Joint Stock Commercial Bank 5.0 billion
